translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Ar Moisés-igar-mesisad unnila ibmar-nuegan-danikoed e-burbagan gued, ibmar-nuegan-danikoed-sunnadsulid. Degisoggu, a-ulale, dulemar ibmar-dula birga-irba uklegedgi Bab-Dummadse-warmakmalad geg nuedga nue imaked.
Dulemar-iskued bela eliena, ibmar-dula-sabsur-ukleged bar uklessulirdo, ar dule bar binsassuliled, an-ulubgi iskued nai-deeye.
Emigindi we-ibmar-dula-ukleged birga-irba iskusmaladgi-anmar-insaega imakdisunnad.
Ar ade moli-bebe-nikad-machered-e-abe, degine, sibadmar-e-abe geg iskued elied.
A-ulale, Cristo we-napnegse dognonigu, Bab Dummadga soged:

content.text: ar anga san guakwaa bur be uksad.

content: Cristo gebe-iduar Bab Dummadga sogsa-gusad:
Sal. 40:6 (Ar wemar Moisés-igar-maidba weyob ukoye sogmai-inigwer.)
Degine, a-sorbali Cristo sogbalid:
Sal. 40:7-8 Weyob sogsagu, Bab-Dummad-gebe-igar-megisad, ibmar-dula-ega-ukleged, a osulosun, igar-binid una messun.
Agi anmar Bab-Dummad-sogedba anmar gwage-swilidik gusisunnad, Jesucristo burgwega na san unnila irgwennaa uksadgi.
Ar napiragwad, bela dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad bane-bane Bab Dummadse gornaid, degine, gannar-gannar ibmar-dula-ukleged uknai-daed, ar wede degite geg iskued-osuloged.
Ar Cristodi unnila na irgwennaa iskued-ular burgwega na san uksa-gusad. Ar emigindi Cristo Bab-Dummad-argan-nuedsik sigidapsunnad.
Emigindi Cristo edarbesisunnad, na bela e-istarmaladgi Bab Dummad nakwedse e-imakedse.
Ar ade unnila na irgwennaa burgwega na san uksadgine, unniguar degi-sadegu Bab-Dummadgadga-gunonimalad gwage-swilidik imaknonikid.
Bab Dummad Burba Nued amba anmarga oyomogad, we napiraye, ar gebe Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaid:

content.text: dulemar-ebo an igar weyob an mesoed:

content: Degine, Bab Dummad Burba Nued sogbalid:
Ar iskued bato osulolesale, geg bar ibmar-dula iskued-ular ukleged.
Jesucristoba nabir anmar Bab Dummadse warmakoed
Degisoggu gwenadgan, anmar Nega-Nued-Ise-Islidikidse Jesucristo-abegi sunna dobsuli doge-gussunnad,
deun igar-nued, igar-dula-dule-imaked, anmar-Bab-Dummad-neggi-mor-naid Jesucristo anmarga egasgu. We sogledo, Jesucristo na e-sangi na anmarga egasye.
Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-maid-neggi Jesucristo anmar-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad an nikmarsoggu,
Bab Dummadse an namarsun, gwage-irgwennaa-binsaedgi, nue Jesúsgi bensulidgi, ibmar-galagwensuli ulubgi-binsaed bela elilesadgi, degine, anmar-sana dii-nuedgi, dii-swilidikidgi nue-enuklesadgi.
Bab Dummad anmar-abonogoed anmar bensulidgi sogdimaladgi nue akamarsun, gwage-gwage dasulidgi. Ar Jesucristo anmar-abonogoye sogsadi, na e-sogsadba ibmar-imakedsegad, anmar-yardakosulid.
Degisoggu, anmar binsamarsun igi anmar saer-gebe, adi na muchub-muchub na gatik sabgumalagar, degine, na ibmar-nuegan-imakmarbaligar.
Degine, mer onmaksuli be gumar Bab-Dummadse-golega, igi baigan damaladyob. Bur na be muchub-muchub ogannomar, adi gatik Bab Dummadba nanamalagar, bur-bule, Bab-Dummad-ibagan warmakdani be dakmalar.
Bab-Dummad-be-abonoged, mer baisur be dakoed
Igar-napiragwad wisid-sorba yamo anmar iskudele, gannar iskued-eliega Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uked sated.
Deyob anmar iskusale, unnila sabsur-odurdakleged, degine, soo-gwabunye-siid Bab-Dummad-e-istarmalad-odurdaklemaloedbi anmar edarbesisunnad.
Dule-warbo, igi, warbaa sognonikile, we Moisés-igar-mesisadgi annasye, we-dulega burgwed-igar-maid, wile-daklego-deeye soglesulid.

¿Ar dule Bab-Dummad-Machigi annasale, degine, e-abegi igar-nabos-megisad, egi nue-nugunonikidgi, a-abe, abe-iskanaga imaksale, degine, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Nued-nabir-dulemargi-binsamaidgi dodogele, a-dule bur-bule odurdaklegosur-be-insae? Bur-bule odurdaklegoe.
Ar anmar Bab-Dummad-wisid, na e-sunnad sogsa-gusad:
Dt. 32:35 Degine, sogbalid:
Dule iskudiidba Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maidse sabsur-odurdaklegega galenonikile, we beedse nunmaked-dummaddo.
Idu-ibagan-nasmalad nue be insamalana, deun a-ibagangine, bemar Bab-Jesús-igar gwallu-meegwadyob abingasmalad-sorba, nue iskued-abin ulusmalad-sorba bemar naibi-gumalad-abin gandik gwisgusmalad.
Imbagwenale, dulemar-abargi bemargi sabsur sunmaklesad, degine, emar-wagab bemar sabsur imaklesmarbalid. Imbagwenale, emar-sabsur-naibi-gunaimalad-yalaba bemar gwichi-gusmarmogad.

Deginbali, dulemar-eskaryagi-mellesimalad bemar wiledaksamarbalid, degine, bemar weligwar-itogedgine, igi-barsaye be sogsamalad, bemar-ibe ibmar-sulearmargu, ar bemar wisid, nibneggine bur ibmar-nued, ibmar-geg-bergued be nikmalad.
Degisoggu, mer be iemar, Bab Dummadgi bensuli nanamalagar, ar ade bemar wisid, bemarga bur-ibmar-dummad uklegoed.
Bur-gatik alamaknai bemar imaker-gebed, adi Bab-Dummad-sogedba ibmar be imaksad-sorba, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-ukoye-sogsad be abingamalagar.
Bab Dummad E-Gardagi soged:
Ar anmardi gannar-sorsik-naed-dulesurmalad anmar-san-burba yoggumalagar. Suli, anmardi Jesucristogi-bensulidba anmar-san-burba abonolemaloed-dulemalad.
